cohort: 12086 fetuses born via C-section (3993 elective, 8093 emergency) at a teaching hospital in Sialkot, Pakistan, with minimum 3 months follow-up.
finding: Fetal morbidity (including URTI, ear infection, skin infection, congenital cardiac malformation, sepsis and mortality)  was higher in fetuses born after emergency caesarean section compared to elective caesarean section.
